name: RideSafe — Ride Monitoring Demo
description: Deterministic synthetic reference profile for the MultiSens v0.7 deployment/resource-tradeoff workflow. RideSafe is a personal front/rear dashcam setup (reference hardware: 70mai) recording a vehicle journey for better visibility and incident evidence - it is ride monitoring and incident-evidence capture, not a safety-certification, driver-monitoring, or occupant-monitoring system, and MultiSens itself never claims to guarantee passenger safety or prevent incidents. Reference sensor ids (ridesafe_front_rgb, ridesafe_rear_rgb) are separate physical camera positions, never merged just because they share a modality. SYNTHETIC DATA - demonstrates functionality only, not a claim about real camera performance. See examples/profiles/README.md.

requirements.name: Baseline scene visibility, daylight
requirements.description: Can this configuration see the road scene clearly during daylight journeys?

requirements.name: Baseline scene visibility, low light
requirements.description: Can this configuration see the road scene during low-light journeys? A looser bar than daylight - low light is a genuinely harder condition for any camera.

requirements.name: Full journey recording, daylight
requirements.description: A stricter bar representing reliable, near-continuous journey documentation - reachable only by combining front and rear coverage.

requirements.name: Full journey recording, low light
requirements.description: The strictest bar in this demo - full front+rear journey documentation at night.
